input_messages.content: Hi! I’d like to make some changes to my upcoming reservation, please.
Sure! My user ID is yara_garcia_1905 and the reservation ID is HXDUBJ.

I’d like to change my outgoing flight to a nonstop flight, departing one day later than originally scheduled. Also, I want to move my return flight from SFO back by one day as well. 

For both flights, I only want options that depart after 8am and before 9pm.

Yes, those options work for me. Please go ahead and change my reservation to those nonstop flights. 

Also, since I have travel insurance, I’d like to confirm that any change fees will be waived, as I’ve read on your website.

Yes, please proceed with those changes. I’m glad to hear the change fees are waived. I’m fine with settling any fare difference using my original payment method. 

Once that’s done, I’d also like to upgrade my ticket to business class and add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know the cost for that?

That’s a bit more than I was hoping to spend. If possible, I’d like to just upgrade to business class for the outgoing flight (HAT072) and keep economy for the return (HAT278). I still want to add 2 checked bags for both flights. Can you let me know the cost for that?
That’s fine, please go ahead and make those changes. I’m okay with the $202 charge and using my original payment method. Thank you!
Yes, please proceed with these changes. Thank you!

Oh, I wasn’t aware of that. I’d prefer to keep economy for both flights if that’s the case, but I still want to add 2 checked bags for both legs. Can you let me know the total cost for just adding the bags? I’ll use my original payment method for that.
Yes, please go ahead and add 2 checked bags for both flights. I’m fine with the $100 charge on my original payment method. Thank you!
That’s all I needed. Thanks for your help! ###STOP###
